subject: Acme MAP: Mutual Action Plan and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Samantha Lee <sam.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme MAP: Mutual Action Plan and next steps

Hi Alex & Samantha,

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap to confirm what we heard and align on a concrete mutual action plan (MAP) so we can keep momentum: 

Pain points you shared:
- High latency on customer-facing chat features during peak (esp. >10k concurrent requests).
- Token costs are unpredictable across current endpoint setups and caching is not applied consistently.
- Need for enterprise-grade audit logs and VPC controls for regulated workflows.

Goals / success criteria:
- Reduce 95th percentile latency to <300ms for 1k concurrent users in pilot.
- Cut per-session token cost by ~30% via caching/batching and model selection.
- Complete security review and procurement by the end of Q2.

Proposed MAP (milestones & owners):
1) Pilot setup & baseline measurement — week of Mar 15 — Owner: Marissa (Redwood) + Alex (Acme) — deliverable: perf baseline report and Runbook.
2) Demo & architecture review — Mar 22 — Owner: Vivek (Redwood) — deliverable: live demo, deployment topology, KV-caching plan.
3) Security/compliance package submission — Mar 24 — Owner: Marissa (Redwood) — deliverable: SOC2 evidence + VPC design doc.
4) Pricing/terms review & procurement kickoff — Apr 2 — Owner: Alex (Acme) + Rishi (Redwood) — deliverable: draft SOW and pricing sheet.
5) Executive decision & contract sign — target by May 15.

Decision process / stakeholders you mentioned:
- Product: Alex (tech buyer) — validating perf and cost.
- Security: Acme Security Team (legal review to follow, contact: legal@acme.com).
- Procurement: Samantha (procurement lead) — owns PO and vendor onboarding.
- Exec sponsor: Tina Park (VP Product) — final sign-off.

Next concrete steps (action items):
- I'll attach the initial MAP spreadsheet and a tailored pricing sheet (attached).
- Vivek will schedule the demo for the week of Mar 22 — proposed times below.
- Alex/Samantha: please confirm the stakeholders who should be on the security packet distribution list.

Proposed demo slots (PST):
- Mon, Mar 22 @ 9:00am or 1:30pm
- Tue, Mar 23 @ 10:00am

Attachments: acme_map_mvp_plan.xlsx, redwood_pricing-sheet.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0187

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>

Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme MAP: Mutual Action Plan and next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is great, appreciate the clear MAP. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Pilot scope: we'll run the pilot against our Payments chatflow (traffic equivalent ~600–1k concurrent). That should map to your baseline target.
- Security reviewers: please include Acme Security (security@acme.com) and Legal (legal@acme.com) on the compliance packet. Our Legal team typically takes ~3 weeks for a first-pass review of T&Cs.
- Procurement timeline: Samantha — can you confirm whether Acme needs an initial SOW or will Procurement accept a standard PO?

Samantha, I can make the Mon Mar 22 1:30pm demo slot — tentatively accept unless you reply with a conflict.

Also happy to take a quick NRE/PO budget ballpark. Rishi — can you paste the rough estimate in the thread so we can see if it'll fit our internal capex window?

Alex
Director of Product, Acme Corp

Hi all — looping in a quick estimate and a couple clarifications from the Redwood side: 

Estimated costs (pilot, 6-week):
- Hosting & inference (model selection + caching): ~$12k–$16k (depends on model choice; we recommend a quantized open model variant for cost/perf).
- Professional services (pilot setup & integration): $8k (one-time).
- Optional: extended retention/audit logs add-on: $2k/mo.

Total pilot budget estimate: $20k–$26k. We can convert this to a short SOW if that helps procurement.

Vivek will send an invite for the demo. Marissa — we should confirm the exact list of endpoints + sample traffic shapes so Vivek can prepare the KV-caching test.
